records.name: Influencing Action Movement
records.summary: Working since 2011, this group matches high school students with mentors and runs workshops, seminars and youth conferences.
records.what_you_do: Students in grades 9 to 12 apply to the mentoring program. Adults can sign up to be mentors on the group's site. The group also holds workshops and a youth conference.

schedule.text: Student mentoring registration is announced each school year. The youth conference is an event; the most recent one announced was for Friday, December 19.

first_step.how: Email info@influencingaction.org to ask about the next student registration, or use the Become a Mentor page on the group's site if you want to mentor.
first_step.basis: Students must apply and mentors must sign up, so the way in is clear but not drop in.

records.notes: Newest item is a December 2 announcement of a December 19 conference. The page does not print the year, but December 19 is a Friday in 2025, which fits. The last student registration notice on the site is from November 2020, so current registration dates are unknown. The 2024 conference was held at Ritter Hall Annex, an event site, not a meeting place. Filing name is Influencing Action Movement Foundation.

records.name: The Jazz Sanctuary
records.summary: A jazz charity serving the Philadelphia region. It holds public concerts at churches and venues and runs Sanctuary Jam and a Jazz Master Class for music students.
records.what_you_do: Go to a public concert on the schedule. Music students can join Sanctuary Jam or the Jazz Master Class. The site does not list volunteer roles, so ask the group about volunteering.

schedule.text: Public and charitable concerts are listed by date on the schedule page, which was updated September 28, 2026. Listed dates are October 8, October 22 and October 26. Event times are not published.

first_step.how: Pick a concert on the schedule page and go, or email music@thejazzsanctuary.com to ask about joining Sanctuary Jam or the Jazz Master Class.
first_step.basis: Concerts on the schedule are public, and an email address for the music programs is published.

records.notes: The schedule page says it was updated 9/28/2026, which is the newest dated item. Event dates show month and day only, so the year is inferred from that update date. The homepage's newest explicitly dated post is a 2023 anniversary party. Listed venues: Trinity Episcopal Church in Buckingham, Bethlehem Baptist Church in Springhouse, Gloria Dei (Old Swedes') Episcopal Church in Philadelphia, and Main Line Unitarian Church in Devon. Most events are outside the city, so this is a regional group. Filing lists a Philadelphia address.

records.name: Keystone Energy Efficiency Alliance
records.summary: A Pennsylvania group that works on state energy policy and runs events, webinars and a membership network for people who work on energy efficiency.
records.what_you_do: Join as a member to use the network and member benefits, or attend the group's events and webinars. The site lists no volunteer roles.

schedule.text: No fixed meeting time is published. Events and webinars are announced on the group's upcoming events list, which we did not open.

first_step.how: Read the Join KEEA page on keealliance.org to see membership levels and benefits, and check the upcoming events list before you sign up.
first_step.basis: Membership comes first for full access, and public event access is not confirmed on the pages we could read.

records.notes: Newest dated item is a December 17, 2025 board announcement, with November and October 2025 news too. A guessed events address returned 404, so the upcoming events list was not read. The group works across Pennsylvania, so Philadelphia is one part of its reach. It also runs a New Jersey sister group, which is out of scope here. Filing address is Friends Center, 1501 Cherry St.

records.name: Common Space Ardmore
records.notes: The group operates as Common Space. Its own site gives an address in Ardmore (19003, Lower Merion Township), so it does not meet in or serve Philadelphia. The filing lists a 19107 Philadelphia address, which may be out of date; not confirmed. The site is working but has no dated items. Legal name is La Piazza Community Center of Ardmore.

records.name: Legal Recruitment Administrators of Philadelphia
records.summary: A Greater Philadelphia association for legal recruiters and legal staff who work in private law firms. Members meet regularly for career development programs.
records.what_you_do: Members attend regular meetings and education programs and can see job openings on the members' job listings page.

first_step.how: Read the Join LRAP page on lraphiladelphia.org to check the membership rules. Membership is open to legal personnel at private law firms in the Greater Philadelphia area.
first_step.basis: Membership is limited to people who work in private law firms, and no meeting schedule is posted.

records.notes: No dated item found; the only date-like text is in an image file path. No meeting dates or contact details were shown on the pages we read. The IRS record and the site use the same name. Membership is narrow, so the fit for community newcomers is limited.

records.name: Let Them Rock
records.summary: A music charity that gives scholarship students access to stages, recording, touring and lessons.
records.what_you_do: Scholarship students apply to take part in the group's instruction and performance programs. Donations are also taken on the Donate page.

first_step.how: Open the Apply page on letthemrock.org. The application details did not show when we read it, so use the site's Contact Us page to ask what the steps are.
first_step.basis: Scholarship students apply first, and the application steps were not visible when we read the site.

records.notes: The only date on the site is a 2023 copyright footer, which is not evidence, so status is unknown. The apply page loaded but showed no application details, and the contact page was not visible. The site lists no meeting place; the filing address is 1804 Rittenhouse Sq. The group describes itself as a charitable fund that also runs programs. If review finds it is only a scholarship fund, hide it as private.

records.name: Lola Sophia Project
records.summary: A nonprofit run by volunteers and paid for by donations, working toward better treatment for dogs with cancer.
records.what_you_do: Volunteers run the group. You can donate, sign up for email updates, or write to the group to ask how to volunteer.

first_step.how: Email gia@lolasophiaproject.org and ask how volunteers can help right now. The site does not list volunteer roles.
first_step.basis: Volunteer roles are not listed on the pages we could read, so the way in is an email.

records.notes: The site works but has no dated item we could read; the only date is a 2024 footer, which is not evidence. The events link was not included in our read. The only tie to Philadelphia is the 19130 filing address; the site does not say where it serves. The interest tag is the closest fit in the animals family, not an exact match, since the group works on canine cancer rather than dog owner social groups.

records.name: Mid-Atlantic District Export Council

Closest verdict is out_of_area; a reviewer may prefer hide (out of scope, business program). Filing address is 1617 JFK Blvd.

notes: Batch of 15 IRS-listed groups. Verdicts: 10 publish, 3 hide, 2 out_of_area. Four publish records (Honor Thy Neighbor, Lets See If We Can Help, Live CarePhilly, Monster Milers) could not be read at all: their websites returned a 500 error or only a title, a domain name or the word Home, so they have no summary, categories or interests and will be held back until someone checks them by hand. Both searches went to Integrity Clique and Kitchen Cred; neither turned up a public presence, so both are hidden as no public way in. Honor Thy Neighbor was retried once and still returned HTTP 500. A guessed events address on keealliance.org returned 404. No rate limiting seen. Searches used 2 of 2 (cap reached). Fetches used 22 of 60.
